data.action: 调整一次呼吸后抬头，将泪水准确凝在眼眶里。
data.camera: close-up, shoulders upward, single continuous face portrait
data.description: 拍摄现场，导演喊开始后她低头调整呼吸，再抬头时眼泪已经精准挂在眼眶里；画面捕捉情绪到位的一瞬间，是她职业能力的最高光。
data.promptProse: Kana lowers her head to control her breathing on the film set, then raises it with precisely held tears at her eyes as the scene begins. Her dark school blazer, white blouse and ribbon frame a continuous shoulder-up portrait. Keep the expression dominant, with only muted studio surfaces behind her. Studio light catches the tear edges and short red hair, shaping her cheeks with soft shadows beneath the eyes.
data.title: 有马加奈 · 10 秒落泪的现场
